ref_text: The lane was busy that afternoon.

lines.text: You know this man is a thief.
So watch closely, because somebody here is about to lose something.
This lane is about to grab somebody.
Nobody needed to see him do it, because everyone here knows what he is.
But he wasn't running away with her wallet.
He was running after her, to give it back.
He'd seen the man who said sorry take it, then drop it at the sight of a constable.
lines.text_kokoro: He'd seen the man who said sorry take it, then drop it at the sight of a [constable](/kˈʌnstəbᵊl/).

lines.text: If you said number two, you were right that he's a thief.
You were wrong about which way he was running.
And the man who said sorry never left the lane.
